value: error: cannot convert from 'const StructWithUint' to 'SomeStructWithBitfields'
note: Example 1's reported symptom: dxc rejects the struct-to-struct cast between a plain-uint struct and a bit-field struct whose bit-fields also total one uint32_t storage unit. The literal diagnostic text is quoted from the issue body itself, so this predicate is anchored to what the reporter actually saw rather than a generalisation over 'cannot convert' (which dxc also emits for genuinely incompatible casts).
